# Clear Error Cluster

![Clear Error Cluster function icon](../../../assets/function-icons/functions/error/02-clear-cluster.svg)

[Error functions](index.md) · [All functions](../index.md)

Resets status to false, code to zero and source to an empty string. Clearing a diagnostic does not repair or retry the failed operation.
